title: Version sorting puts pre-releases in the wrong place
prompt: The version helpers in this project (parse, compare, range matching, sorting) follow semantic versioning but have bugs. `1.0.0-alpha` must sort before `1.0.0`; numeric pre-release identifiers compare as numbers (`1.0.0-alpha.2` is lower than `1.0.0-alpha.10`) and are lower than alphanumeric ones; a longer pre-release is higher than its prefix (`1.0.0-alpha` < `1.0.0-alpha.1`); and caret ranges for 0.x versions must stay inside the leftmost non-zero part (`^0.2.3` means `>=0.2.3 <0.3.0`, `^0.0.3` means `>=0.0.3 <0.0.4`). Build metadata (`+build`) must keep being ignored when comparing. Fix the causes. Run the tests with `npm test`.
